title: skenv file
description: The skenv file of a repository: skenv.toml, skenv.yaml, skenv.yml or skenv.json in its root. [repository] is the development tooling of a skills repository, [user] the manifest (the skills of your agents), [project] the skills a project repository carries. Rules the schema cannot check are enforced by skenv: skill names are unique across checkouts and dependencies (and across dependencies and from entries of [project]), user.unmanaged must not match a selected skill, project.dir and project.mirrors do not overlap, and a directory holds only one skenv file. Docs: https://qunaxis.github.io/skenv/skenv-file

$schema.description: The URL of this schema, for editors. skenv ignores it.

user.description: A public repository must not carry [user]: the manifest is personal (home paths, machine names, which skills you use). Keep it in a private repository.
user.errorMessage: A public repository must not carry [user]: the manifest is personal. Keep it in a private repository.

repository.description: The [repository] section of the skenv file: the development tooling of a skills repository that `skenv repo apply` generates, and its publication policy.

template_version.description: The version of the templates this repository asks for, which is also the skenv release its generated CI installs. It must not be newer than the templates of the skenv that reads it.

visibility.description: The declared publication policy: "private" or "public". skenv never reads or changes the access setting on the hosting service. A public repository must not carry [user], and its CI runs `skenv lint --publish` on the runners of the host (ubuntu-latest on GitHub, the shared runners on GitLab).

ci.description: The CI system the templates generate for, by the table present: github (.github/workflows/check.yml) or gitlab (.gitlab-ci.yml), at most one. Without either: github. Switching it makes `skenv repo apply` remove the managed file of the other one.
Chooses the CI system: one of its tables.

not.errorMessage: Keep one CI table: github or gitlab.

runs_on.description: The runs-on labels of the jobs of a private repository. Default: ["self-hosted", "linux", "docker"]; use ["ubuntu-latest"] for the GitHub-hosted runners. A public repository always runs on ubuntu-latest, and setting it there is an error.

items.patternErrorMessage: A runner label: letters, digits and . _ : / -

tags.description: The runner tags of the jobs of a private repository. Default: ["self-hosted", "linux", "docker"]; use ["saas-linux-small-amd64"] for the GitLab.com instance runners. A public repository always runs on the shared runners, and setting it there is an error.

items.patternErrorMessage: A runner label: letters, digits and . _ : / -

user.description: The [user] section of the skenv file: the skills made available to the agents of the current OS user, across projects, on every machine that runs `skenv sync`. Local paths may start with "~"; relative ones resolve against the directory of the skenv file.

checkouts.description: Git repositories kept as editable working copies, by an ID of your choice: every selected skill directory in them is linked, and edits show up immediately.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: An ID is lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter or digit.

dependencies.description: Single skills pinned to a commit and copied into the store, keyed by the installed skill name. Skill names are unique across checkouts and dependencies.

not.errorMessage: "synced" is reserved: ~/.claude/skills/synced is managed by Claude.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: A skill name is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.

machines.description: Holds rules for one machine each, keyed by the machine name: the tool config `machine`, else $SKENV_MACHINE, else the full hostname, else the short one (never both).

agents.description: Chooses the agent directories that get a link per skill.

storage.description: Where skenv keeps the skills it installs.

unmanaged.description: Lists glob patterns over entry names (no "/") in the store and the agent directories that belong to other tools: doctor does not report them and sync never touches them, not even with --adopt. A selected skill must not match a pattern.

items.patternErrorMessage: A glob over entry names, without "/".

git_hosts.description: Declares git servers by alias, usually self-hosted ones: "<alias>:group/repo" in repo is a repository on that server. They live in the manifest so it resolves the same on every machine.

not.errorMessage: This prefix is built in and cannot be declared.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: An alias is lowercase letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter.

checkout.description: A git repository kept as an editable working copy, so that edits show up immediately. Ownership does not matter: your repository, a fork or a team repository.

repo.description: The repository to clone: "owner/repo" or "github:owner/repo" on github.com, "gitlab:group/sub/repo", "codeberg:owner/repo", "<alias>:path" of a host in git_hosts, or a full git URL.

checkout_dir.description: Where the working copy lives: "~/..." in the home directory, a relative path against the directory of this file ("." is the repository that holds the manifest). Point it at the existing clone, or sync clones a second one there.

skills_dir.description: The directory inside the repository whose subdirectories with a SKILL.md are the skills. Default: "skills".
skills_dir.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

include.description: Lists skill names and glob patterns over names (no "/") of the skills to install. Omitted: every skill, including ones added later; [] selects none. A name without a pattern that is not a skill of the repository is an error.

items.patternErrorMessage: A skill name or a glob over names, without "/".

exclude.description: Lists skill names and glob patterns over names (no "/") that are not installed, applied after include; exclude wins. A pattern that matches nothing is fine.

items.patternErrorMessage: A skill name or a glob over names, without "/".

dependency.description: A single skill pinned to a commit; `skenv vendor add|update|remove` edit these entries (with --project, the ones of [project]). Its key is the installed skill name: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end; "synced" is reserved.

repo.description: The repository: "owner/repo" or "github:owner/repo" on github.com, "gitlab:group/sub/repo", "codeberg:owner/repo", "<alias>:path" of a host in git_hosts, or a full git URL.

skill_dir.description: The directory with SKILL.md inside the repository, relative to its root; "." for the root. Default: ".".
skill_dir.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

commit.description: The full 40-character lowercase commit SHA. Branches, tags and short SHAs are rejected: a dependency changes only when you update it.
commit.patternErrorMessage: A full 40-character lowercase commit SHA; branches, tags and short SHAs are not allowed.

machine.description: Holds the rules of one machine. They only narrow the skills the sources select: a machine cannot install a skill its checkout excludes.

include.description: Lists skill names and glob patterns over names (no "/"): on this machine only matching skills are installed. Omitted: all; [] selects none.

items.patternErrorMessage: A skill name or a glob over names, without "/".

exclude.description: Lists skill names and glob patterns over names (no "/") that are not installed on this machine, applied after include.

items.patternErrorMessage: A skill name or a glob over names, without "/".

checkout_dirs.description: Overrides checkout_dir on this machine, by checkout ID.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: An ID is lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter or digit.

agents.description: Chooses the agent directories that get a link per skill. The built-in agents are "claude" ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills, else ~/.claude/skills) and "pi" (~/.pi/agent/skills). Codex and other agents that follow the ~/.agents/skills convention read the store directly.

enabled.description: Lists the built-in agents to link skills for, whether or not they are installed. Omitted: each built-in agent whose base directory (~/.claude, ~/.pi/agent) exists; []: none.

paths.description: Overrides the skills directory of a built-in agent, by name; the other agents keep theirs.

extra_dirs.description: More directories that get a link per skill, added to the agents, never replacing them.

storage.description: Where skenv keeps the skills it installs.

dir.description: The store: links to the skills of checkouts, copies of dependencies. Codex reads the default one directly. Default: "~/.agents/skills".

gitHost.description: A git server declared in the manifest, usually a self-hosted one: "<alias>:group/repo" is a repository on it. It lives in the manifest rather than in the tool config, so the manifest resolves the same on every machine.

base_url.description: The base of the repositories on the server, and its scheme is the transport: "https://git.example.com" clones <base_url>/group/repo.git over https, "ssh://git@git.example.com" (with an optional port and path prefix) over ssh. It must not carry a password or https credentials; use a git credential helper or an ssh key.
base_url.patternErrorMessage: A base URL such as "https://git.example.com" (no credentials) or "ssh://git@git.example.com".

provider.description: The software of the server: "github", "gitlab" (subgroups of any depth), "gitea" (Gitea, Forgejo) or "generic" (any path, cloned as written, ".git" is not added). It sets the accepted paths and is recorded for CI templates and imports. Default: "generic".

project.description: The [project] section of a skenv file: the skills a project repository carries, committed with it, so that everyone who clones it (and CI, and cloud agents) gets them. `skenv sync` inside the repository copies the pinned skills into dir and keeps the mirrors in line.

dir.description: The directory, relative to the repository root, that holds the project's skills: the copies skenv makes and the skills authored there, which skenv never changes. Default: ".agents/skills".

not.errorMessage: dir must be a directory inside the repository, not its root.

dir.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

mirrors.description: Other agent directories, relative to the repository root, that get every skill of dir, for example ".claude/skills" for Claude Code. Default: none.

not.errorMessage: A mirror is a directory inside the repository, not its root.

items.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

mirrors_mode.description: How a mirror gets a skill: "symlink" makes <mirror>/<name> a relative symlink to <dir>/<name>, "copy" a full copy for tools that do not follow symlinks (or Windows checkouts). Default: "symlink".

git_hosts.description: Declares git servers by alias for the repo values of this section, as user.git_hosts does for the manifest: the project resolves them the same for everyone who clones it, without anyone's manifest.

not.errorMessage: This prefix is built in and cannot be declared.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: An alias is lowercase letters, digits and "-", starting with a letter.

dependencies.description: Third-party skills, each pinned to a commit and copied into dir, keyed by the skill name.

not.errorMessage: "synced" is reserved: ~/.claude/skills/synced is managed by Claude.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: A skill name is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.

from.description: Lists skills repositories (your own, for example) to copy some of their skills from, each pinned to one commit, by an ID of your choice.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: An ID is lowercase letters, digits, "-" and "_", starting with a letter or digit.

from.description: Names skills of a skills repository, copied into the project at a pinned commit.

repo.description: The repository: "owner/repo" or "github:owner/repo" on github.com, "gitlab:group/sub/repo", "codeberg:owner/repo", "<alias>:path" of a host in project.git_hosts, or a full git URL.

skills_dir.description: The directory inside the repository whose subdirectories are the skills. Default: "skills".
skills_dir.patternErrorMessage: A relative path inside the repository ("." for its root), without "..", empty segments or a trailing "/".

skills.description: Lists the skills to copy, by directory name under skills_dir (no patterns). Required: every copy is committed to the project, so each is named.

not.errorMessage: "synced" is reserved: ~/.claude/skills/synced is managed by Claude.

items.patternErrorMessage: A skill name is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with no hyphen at the start or end.

commit.description: The full 40-character lowercase commit SHA to copy the skills at.
commit.patternErrorMessage: A full 40-character lowercase commit SHA; branches, tags and short SHAs are not allowed.
